newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 28-day bills average accepted yield 4.54 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 28-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 4.54 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compared with the average accepted yield of the previous 28-day bills tender of 4.78 percent on November 26.
Bids for the HK$5.0 billion issue totalled HK$16 billion against HK$18.39 billion last week, it said. The average tender yield was 4.59 percent.
This was the second of three special 28-day issues to facilitate the implementation of the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) system in December 9.
The third 28-day Exchange Fund bills tender with an issue size of HK$10 billion will be tendered on December 5.

The HKMA said earlier the decision to launch a third special issue with a larger size was due to the very strong demand from banks for additional supply of bills in preparation for the implementation of the RTGS system.
Under the RTGS system, banks can make use of Exchange Fund bills and notes to obtain interest free intraday liquidity by carrying out intraday repurchase transactions with the HKMA.
